content: Great Expectations is a full data-quality/profiling/documentation framework built for large-scale and distributed pipelines (Spark etc.); it is usable on small projects but is heavier than needed for pure structural/type/nullability checks. Lighter alternatives (Cerberus, Pydantic-style validators) fit small CSV validation better when requirements are simple and fixed -- reinforces that a small custom structural/type/nullability validator (as opposed to adopting a full data-quality framework) is the right-sized choice for this project's explicitly narrow validation scope.
